title: Medtronic, frequently disconnecting on 3.4.2.1
symptom: Medtronic 754/722 pumps frequently disconnect, possibly since January changes. Users report having to downgrade to 3.3.2.1 to resolve, and one user on 3.4.2.3 still has the issue, only connecting on phone reboot once.
fix: Downgrade to version 3.3.2.1 as a workaround.
evidence_quote: 3.3.2.1 is the version I've gone back to, will try 3.4.0.0, thanks
